declaration scope SixtyPercentAssetTest:
  input total_assets content money
  input non_remic_qualifying_assets content money
  input remic_interest_amount content money
  input remic_qualifying_asset_proportion content decimal
  internal effective_remic_amount content money
  output meets_test content boolean

scope SixtyPercentAssetTest:

definition effective_remic_amount equals
    if remic_qualifying_asset_proportion >= 0.95
    then remic_interest_amount
    else remic_interest_amount * remic_qualifying_asset_proportion

definition meets_test equals
    non_remic_qualifying_assets + effective_remic_amount >= total_assets * 0.60

declaration scope SubparagraphGTest:
  input substantially_all_properties_leased content boolean
  input lease_date content date
  input effective_lease_term content duration
  input gross_income_from_leases_and_af_sources content money
  input total_gross_income_excluding_dividends_and_capital_gains content money
  output meets_subparagraph_g content boolean

declaration scope SubparagraphHTest:
  input gross_income_from_af_sources content money
  input total_gross_income_excluding_capital_gains content money
  input is_in_affiliated_group_with_regulated_utility content boolean
  input dividends_interest_and_g_lease_income_from_regulated_utility content money
  internal effective_af_source_income content money
  output meets_subparagraph_h content boolean

scope SubparagraphGTest:
  definition meets_subparagraph_g equals
    substantially_all_properties_leased and
    lease_date < |1954-01-01| and
    effective_lease_term > 20 year and
    gross_income_from_leases_and_af_sources >=
      total_gross_income_excluding_dividends_and_capital_gains * 0.80

scope SubparagraphHTest:
  definition effective_af_source_income equals
    if is_in_affiliated_group_with_regulated_utility
    then gross_income_from_af_sources +
         dividends_interest_and_g_lease_income_from_regulated_utility
    else gross_income_from_af_sources

definition meets_subparagraph_h equals
    effective_af_source_income >=
      total_gross_income_excluding_capital_gains * 0.80

signals.description: Subparagraph G requires 'substantially all' railroad properties to be leased but provides no numerical threshold for 'substantially all'.
signals.option_a: Treat as a factual boolean determination (substantially_all_properties_leased) supplied by the caller.
signals.option_b: Adopt an 80% threshold by analogy to the gross income tests in G and H.

signals.description: Subparagraph D conditions its rate requirement on meeting 'the requirements of subparagraph (A)', but child A's formalization (ServiceType_33_A) captured only service type categories, not A's rate regulation conditions.
signals.option_a: Formalize A's rate regulation requirements as a separate scope and reference it from the D classification path.
signals.option_b: Treat D's rate condition as a boolean input rates_meet_subparagraph_a_requirements supplied by the caller.
